intro: We are a small practice working across architecture, interiors and engineering. Keeping all three under one roof means the drawing and the building stay the same thing.
statement: Good space is not decoration. It is orientation, light, air and proportion - decided early, when they are still free to decide.
about: Chetan Borkar Associates works on homes, workplaces and retail across Maharashtra. Projects range from a fifty-square-metre apartment refit to buildings of well over a thousand.
We take work from first sketch through to handover. Drawings are produced to be built from, not to be admired, and we stay on site while they are.
